market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-neutral. Fed hike expectations and $97 oil create headwinds. Energy inflation pressures consumer sectors. AI names face profit-taking after insider selling. Watch for volatility spike if Iran conflict escalates further. Stocks already falling on jobs data.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. AI capex cycle structurally intact (Foxconn, Monolithic, Palantir validate). China rotation offers valuation arbitrage. Energy infrastructure demand from AI data centers is multi-year. But geopolitical fragmentation and rate uncertainty cap upside. Favor quality and income over speculative growth.
